case_title.quote: SATYA NARAYANA TIWARI AND ANR. V. STATE OF U.P.

number_of_accused.quote: Only the husband and mother-in-law of the deceased have been accused of the offences

accused_gender.quote: The appellants - the husband and mother-in-law of the deceased
accused_gender.reason: One accused is male, the other female.

accused_age.reason: 24 is the victim's age; the accused's age is not stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Not stated for the accused; the father-in-law's State Bank job is not theirs.

victim_age.quote: The deceased was aged about 24 years

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the husband and mother-in-law of the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Spouse covers only accused 1; accused 2 is mother-in-law.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 304B, 498-A IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act

weapon.correct_value: Ligature (cloth) for strangulation and kerosene with fire
weapon.quote: A half burnt cloth around her neck with a knot
weapon.reason: Cloth ligature and kerosene were used, so 'None mentioned' is wrong.

evidence_type.quote: this case is also based on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, medical and recovery evidence all feature.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: first strangulating her and then setting her afire

trial_court_outcome.quote: were acquitted by the trial court

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Dowry death (s.304-B), cruelty (s.498-A), and s.4 Dowry Prohibition Act
offence_finally_established.quote: committed the offences under Sections 498-A and 304 B IPC and under Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act

imprisonment_type.quote: awarded life sentence under Section 304B IPC
imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment is the main sentence.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: Life; 3 years RI (498A); 6 months RI (s.4 DPA)
imprisonment_years.quote: 3 years rigorous imprisonment under Section 498A, and six months rigorous imprisonment
imprisonment_years.reason: Null ignores the stated terms for the other offences.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts without conclusions: the husband and mother-in-law were charged after the bride died; the father alleged a Maruti car demand.
neutral_facts.quote: The accused were found to have committed the crime
neutral_facts.reason: Reveals the outcome by saying the accused were found guilty, and it wrongly calls the mother-in-law 'the accused's mother-in-law'.

offence_severity.quote: life sentence under Section 304B IPC, 3 years rigorous imprisonment under Section 498A

physical_harm.quote: suffocation with shock as a result of strangulation with simultaneous A/M burn

number_of_offences.correct_value: Three offences: ss.304-B, 498-A IPC and s.4 Dowry Prohibition Act
number_of_offences.quote: convicted them under Sections 304B, 498-A IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Dowry demand of a Maruti car; no property loss stated
financial_property_loss.quote: Maruti car be part of the dowry
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment says dowry demanded; 'Not applicable' is questionable, though no loss is quantified.

premeditation_planning.quote: the crime was committed by the two accused with preplanning

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Testimony of PW1 and PW2, medical/post-mortem evidence, recoveries, and false report/absconding
key_evidence_accepted.quote: ingredients No. 3, 4 and 5 ... established by satisfactory evidence
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Omits medical evidence, recoveries and conduct, though not wrong.

witness_credibility.quote: quite credible regarding the illegal demand of a Maruti Car

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused absconded, surrendered on 7.11.2000 and 13.11.2000, and the mother-in-law lodged a false suicide report
post_offence_conduct.quote: lodged a false report at the police station that her daugther-in-law had committed suicide
post_offence_conduct.reason: Omits the false report; surrender dates are fine.

bail_history.correct_value: This Court granted bail on 27.10.2005; bail bonds cancelled
bail_history.quote: On 27.10.2005 this Court had granted bail to the appellants.

trial_duration.correct_value: FIR 3.11.2000; HC judgment 12.07.2005; SC decided 28.10.2010 (trial duration not stated)
trial_duration.reason: Dates are stated, but this is not a trial duration, and the SC date comes from the header.

legal_representation.quote: Indu Malhotra, Rajesh and Vivek Jain for the Appellants

investigation_status.quote: after investigation a charge sheet was filed

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: No charge under s.302 IPC was framed though the case warranted it
procedural_irregularity.quote: no charge under Section 302 IPC was levelled
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court noted failure to frame a s.302 charge.

appeal_history.quote: acquitted by the trial court but the High Court convicted them

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution case: dowry demand, harassment, homicidal death shown by recoveries and injuries
prosecution_argument.quote: the prosecution has been able to prove the following
prosecution_argument.reason: Largely consistent but the knot/phone points are the court's findings rather than argument.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence argued suicide, alibi, post-mortem manipulation, and that the demand was not 'soon before' death
defence_argument.quote: the alleged demand of Maruti Car made after about six months of marriage does not answer the test of 'soon before'
defence_argument.reason: The knot and 'superfluous approach' points are the court's findings, not defence arguments.

legal_principle_applied.quote: in order to attract application of Section 304B IPC, the essential ingredients are

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Kunhiabdulla Versus State of Kerala, 2004 (4) SCC 13

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Sentence upheld as the s.304-B conviction stood; court remarked such cases deserve death but could not impose it for lack of a s.302 charge
sentencing_rationale.quote: since no charge under Section 302 IPC was levelled, we cannot do so
sentencing_rationale.reason: The sentence was not imposed because of rarest of rare; that was only an obiter remark.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Brutal, barbaric bride-burning; persistent dowry demand; two perpetrators; false report and absconding
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Largely supported but slightly overstated as sentencing factors.

other_sentence_order.quote: Their bail bonds are cancelled. They shall be taken into custody forthwith
